label: rem:pion-half-figure-eight-decay-reading
title: Pion decay as an inverted half-rotation
html: The pion decay \pi \to \mu + \nu de-entangles V_{(2,1)}. Read through the phase identity, the decay inverts a half-Reeb-rotation: it releases the energy stored in the phase \theta. Two such decays would undo a full figure-eight rotation, which is how this reading connects meson decay to the lepton mass ratio. The connection is interpretive; the proposition itself states only the equality of phases.
